title: Tooling: 44× faster production verify_factor via packed-row equality with identical receipts
body:
## Change and scope

At base `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, `scripts/experiments/complex_centers.py:verify_factor` still used the historical nested entrywise loop over all scatter/gather pairs. Ross Richardson’s opt-in adapter `research/central-factor-packed/` already proved an injective packed-row algorithm with identical receipts. This PR wires that equivalent check into the **production** source used by `scripts/audit_complex_centers.py` / `make verify-certificates`.

Only the source pin for `scripts/experiments/complex_centers.py` changes inside `certificates/dyadic-central-factor.json`. Every coefficient is still checked; factor generators, side/phase obligations and the retained historical `2^-31` language are unchanged.

**Tooling improvement; no new kappa.** Selected frontier untouched.

## Result

On Linux / CPython 3.12.3 (Linux-6.12.94+-x86_64-with-glibc2.39), five alternating fresh-process pairs gave median wall time:

- **factor-only:** **2.615 → 0.059 seconds (44.06×)**
- **complete audit:** **5.784 → 3.356 seconds (1.72×)**

Timing is host-descriptive and is not a correctness gate. Every `verify_factor` receipt matches the baseline checker fieldwise.

Package: `research/central-factor-production/`.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/central-factor-production/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/central-factor-production/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/central-factor-production
python3.12 -I -B research/central-factor-production/benchmark.py --rounds 5
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_CENTRAL_FACTOR_PRODUCTION heights=[8, 10, 12, 18, 26] ... no_new_kappa
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/central-factor-production outcome=completed
PASS_IDENTICAL_CENTRAL_FACTOR_PRODUCTION_RECEIPTS
```

Default verify is read-only. Coefficient-mismatch and temp-copy corruption controls reject; `require` gates remain under `-O`. Full `make verify`, selected cold replay, Lean, and multiplication-theorem obligations were not rerun for this isolated historical-checker change.

## Overlap and credit

Closest priors (different delivery): Ross Richardson’s `research/central-factor-packed/` (opt-in packed adapter; this is the production wiring), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#756](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/756), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#2117](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2117) (same `dyadic-central-factor.json`, different pin key `disjoint_tensor.py`). No competing open PR on production `verify_factor` at refresh.

Douglas R. Colkitt authored the dyadic central factor and original checker. Ross Richardson authored the packed algorithm. Prepared by Wentao Li ([VictorLiwentao](https://github.com/VictorLiwentao), [@Is__Victor](https://x.com/Is__Victor)) with substantial AI assistance, under Apache-2.0.
